description: Turn something you already have into a file you can send someone: a web page, a print-ready page you can save as a PDF, or plain text. Nothing about MentionFox appears on it, and you can put your own name, logo and colours on it, so it goes to a client as your work. Use it for "send me that as a PDF", "I need this as a document for the client", "put our branding on it". This makes a fixed copy of what exists now — for something that keeps up to date as the information changes, share the live link instead. Costs 5 credits.

branding.description: Optional. Your own branding on the file, so it goes out as your work.

company_name.description: Your company name, shown in the header.

font_family.description: A font name, for example Inter.

footer_text.description: A line for the footer, for example your address or a disclaimer.

logo_url.description: A link to your logo image, for example https://example.com/logo.png.

primary_color.description: Main colour as a hex code, for example #0F172A.

secondary_color.description: Accent colour as a hex code, for example #F27A3A.

format.description: html: a web page. pdf: a print-ready page to save as a PDF. markdown: plain text. Default html.

report_id.description: Which one. For a dossier, the person id from get_dossier (person_profile_id). For a compare, the names separated by commas, for example "Ada Lovelace, Alan Turing". For the others, the id the earlier result gave.

report_type.description: What to turn into a file: dossier (the file on one person), compare (a side-by-side), or one of the evaluation types.

name: export_report

content.description: The file itself (the page or the text).

credits_charged.description: Credits this call took. 0 when nothing was charged.

download_url.description: A link to download the file.

error.description: Present when the call could not do the work; says why and that nothing was charged where that is so.

message.description: A plain note about the answer, for example why candidates were returned instead of a result.

pricing_note.description: What this call cost and what a repeat costs.

report_type.description: What was turned into a file.

title: Make a sendable file
